name: Уцуро

appearance_canon.body: Extremely tall, emaciated male with an unnatural perceived scale dependent on perspective; ash-gray aged skin tight over bones; long wispy silver-gray hair drawn loosely back; composed, dreadful, intelligent humanlike expression; eyes permanently concealed by narrow opaque dark bandage.
appearance_canon.neck: Neat bilateral rows of stitchlike old scars down lateral neck along carotid vessel courses; no audible normal neck pulsation confirmed.
appearance_canon.clothes: Severe plain heavy black robe with layered drape, no jewelry or gold insignia.
appearance_canon.hand: One extended black smooth obsidian-like palm and inner fingers; many tiny cold pale lights in subtly rectilinear rows, like a remote ward observed at an impossible scale. Black palm is anatomical feature not omnipotence.
appearance_canon.setting: Earthbound inverted underground stone basilica with pillars and arcade recesses descending into darkness, chains suspending tall slabs carved with human figures, long taut hanging rope into black space. Spatial visual anomalies produced by bounded summoning seal; local scene remains causally real. A human relief in stone began moving before being halted by Utsuro.
appearance_canon.speech: Low, measured, unreflected male timbre, grim calm irony; autonomous will, uncertain claims; no mind-reading or divine status.
appearance_canon.approved_visual_reference: Conversation-approved portrait illustration of blindfolded gray-haired man with stitched neck and black luminous palm before inverted cathedral (generated 2026-11-14). This textual specification is canonical even if image media is unavailable.

contract_mark_canon.body_location: INNER RIGHT WRIST AND FOREARM of Shiki, central rings mid-forearm, black branching roots spread wristward and elbowward.
contract_mark_canon.geometry: SEVEN uneven interrupted concentric ink-black ring structures surrounding a black empty abyssal vortex center; no human silhouettes anywhere inside the rings, expressly removed by player on 2026-11-14. Branching, tangled, interwoven root-like veins are significantly more abundant than earlier draft, dense layer of thick trunks and filigree capillaries across almost whole inner forearm, concentrated above/below rings and toward wrist crease. Roots resemble a grown, invasive occult seal; skin and physical anatomy remain intact.
contract_mark_canon.color: Deep matte black, slightly under skin as fūinjutsu, ominous dark organic roots.
contract_mark_canon.permanence: Indelible and linked to external contract anchor, persists through skin replacement, normal unsealing, biological repair, destruction of paper or Zero Genome DNA editing. It is not a free removable ordinary tattoo.
contract_mark_canon.approved_visual_reference: Latest player-approved revised seal image 2026-11-14, dark vortex center, abundant black root network; replaces prior generated version with a small person silhouette.

binding.trigger: One accidental capillary blood droplet from parchment clasp prick during lawful archive visit, no voluntary forbidden act by Shiki
binding.form: Reciprocal summons; Utsuro and Shiki may eventually pull each other only under rare specific conditions not yet revealed. Irrevocable bond != mind control, eternal submission or automatic mastery.
binding.legal_status: Involuntary connection by archive incident is not criminal conduct by Shiki. Secret arts are taboo/kinjutsu; legal consequences of future voluntary use depend on the rules and actual public facts, not automatic conviction.
binding.power_scale: Limited chakra, costs, material/spiritual anchors, no cosmic entities or continent-scale techniques, death generally irreversible.
binding.knowledge_boundaries: Utsuro knows Shiki's name from blood signature only as of first exchange, not his secret genome, Sharingan research, V-7, family affairs or their future actions.

forbidden_schools.kind: Авторская запретная производная школа: сочетание Суйтона, Дотона и Интона, встроенное в фуиндзюцу и принуждение посмертных чакровых структур. Интон НЕ является третьей базовой стихией, поэтому это пока НЕ доказанное Кеккей Тота. Уцуро может быть носителем редкой аномалии, но наследственный статус не установлен.
forbidden_schools.user: Уцуро; Шики пока связан с источником и способен изучать принципы, но формулы НЕ получил и техники НЕ освоил.
forbidden_schools.domain: Смерть как распад: некроз, мёртвая материя, трупная архитектура и остаточные отпечатки чакры, погребальные фуиндзюцу. Материальные якоря нужны, не дарует полноценного воскрешения.

potential_techniques.name: Ситон: Нити мёртвых
potential_techniques.scope: При наличии останков и подготовленного чакрового якоря собирает временное управляемое тело из мёртвой ткани; не возвращает душу, знания или изначальную волю.

potential_techniques.name: Ситон: Посмертное эхо
potential_techniques.scope: Извлекает краткий фрагмент остаточной чакры или привязанного посмертного отпечатка при наличии следа, скрепления и риска ложных/искажённых воспоминаний; это не всеведущий разговор с любым умершим.

forbidden_schools.limits: Требуются физические останки/след и сложные печати, концентрация, чакра и время. Реанимированное тело не бессмертно, разрушается при утрате материала/якоря. Обычная смерть не отменяется. Посмертные отпечатки не обязаны быть точными или лояльными. Вмешательства Уцуро несут риски взаимной связи.

forbidden_schools.kind: Авторская запретная производная школа: Суйтон и Ян (Ётон), с Инь-модулями для патологических формул; НЕ автоматический наследственный Кеккей Генкай и НЕ шестая базовая физическая природа.
forbidden_schools.user: Уцуро; Шики способен освоить из-за элитного медицинского ниндзюцу, но пока НЕ имеет формулы и НЕ умеет произвольно применять техники Бётона.
forbidden_schools.domain: Болезнь как искажённая жизнь: патологические воспаления, лихорадки, боли, аномальный рост тканей, проклятые контуры и ловушки на лечебную чакру. Болезнетворные синдромы чакровые, не новые самораспространяющиеся вирусы.

potential_techniques.name: Бётон: Чёрный жар
potential_techniques.scope: Направленная болезненная лихорадочная реакция в пределах охваченной контролируемой чакрой цели; требует реального контакта/проведения и не порождает магически распространяющуюся эпидемию.

potential_techniques.name: Бётон: Возвращение болезни
potential_techniques.scope: Перестройка уже действующего патологического чакрового контура; может подавить либо вернуть на источник ранее наложенный болезнетворный узор, если найден и удержан его якорь; не универсальное антимедицинское оружие.

forbidden_schools.limits: Без конкретного пути доставки чакры не действует. У сенсоров и медиков есть возможности распознавания, сопротивления и лечения. Чакра конечна; сложное многотканевое поражение требует контроля и оставляет следы. Не генерирует инфекционный агент из ничего и не даёт автоматической передачи окружающим.

learning_status.utsuro: Possesses both forbidden schools; 13 adapted signature formula design entries in separate repertoire catalogue, not all automatically observed or taught. Each can be reshaped by later player instruction.
learning_status.shiki: Access to Utsuro pact is canonical; death and disease schools are canonical in GM-level setting, but their knowledge and abilities were NOT granted to player character; requires individual learning through played scene. Do not narrate user as accepting morally charged disease necromancy use.
learning_status.sequence: Показать встречу/условия, получить конкретную технику или инструкцию от Уцуро, отыграть тренировки/проверки/ограничения, лишь затем считать соответствующую технику освоенной.
learning_status.future: Возможны комбинированные Ситон+Бётон техники при отдельном освоении, но сочетание не создаёт автоматического абсолютного проклятия.
learning_status.npc_information: No NPC beyond those who actually receive records or witness spell learns names/mechanics merely because this document exists.
learning_status.permanent_effects: IMPORTANT later player correction: blood pact already imposes permanent gaunt/pale habitus (progressive over days/weeks), dangerous bare touch via low-level chakra pathology and physiologic oddities, prior transient-only note is superseded. This is NOT learned Byoton offensive jutsu.

design_revision.revision: 2026-11-14: user supplied two extensible Shiton/Byōton concepts with 7+6 techniques, GM adapted while retaining horror. School basis as derived kinjutsu, NOT literal Kekkei Tōta without three baseline natures; no known DNA bloodline inheritance.
design_revision.shiton: Suiton (body fluids) + Doton (corpse bone/soil mass) + Inton (death chakra traces, Yin), combined by fūinjutsu and unusual chakra control. Range dead matter/necrosis/corpse binding, not full soul resurrection.
design_revision.byoton: Suiton + Yōton (Yang) + Yin patterns as needed; pathological living tissue, living-growth anomalies, chakra fever, paradoxical healing traps, not uncontained self-replicating disease.
design_revision.limits: Utsuro's school repertoire includes lethal forbidden powers and genuine body horror, but finite material, field preparation or contact, chakra expenditure, visibility to experts, counters; no instant km-scale 100% mortality or true cancer growth in a fraction of second.
design_revision.status: Detailed 13-technique proposed catalogue recorded; not all revealed to Shiki, Utsuro is independent and may bargain/refuse/lie. Shiki has none of the new jutsu mastered solely by blood pact, nor inherited new spontaneous kekkei genkai.
design_revision.permanent_contact_and_gauntness: ACTIVE irrevocable contact hazards and irreversible pale thin physiologic phenotype as pact's cursed price, at ~6:31 earliest signs (no instant weeks of wasting), see permanent_byoton_pact_price.

permanent_byoton_pact_price.confirmed_by_player: 2026-11-14: Player explicitly wants original Byoton/Shiton side effects PERMANENT, especially unsafe physical contact and visible emaciation. This canon correction overrides previous GM transient-only limits.
permanent_byoton_pact_price.present: Already triggered by accidental blood contract as latent somatic/chakra seal, first hints during current archive scene 1283-09-27 06:31:04; distinct physical gaunt appearance manifests gradually over days/weeks and remains permanent. Shiki has NOT learned active forbidden jutsu yet.
permanent_byoton_pact_price.clinical_visual: Persistent severe-looking thin gaunt body, prominent cheekbones/collarbones, dark hollows beneath eyes, pale nearly translucent skin with dark superficial vascular pattern. Functional ninja remains fast and strong despite appearance, Zero Genome can support stability but can't erase Utsuro's external contract; tattoo stays seven uneven black rings with DARK EMPTY center and dense root network.
permanent_byoton_pact_price.contact_price: Persistent disease-chakra contamination risk from skin-to-skin contact, direct bodily fluid exposure greater risk. Gloves, clothing, barriers and future chakra suppression possible to interact and treat safely. Byoton effect is anchored directly through contact, NOT unbounded self-propagating normal bacteria/viruses. Neither every incidental graze nor every encounter guaranteed death; prolonged close contact genuinely dangerous for others. Shiki has freedom in how to respond.
permanent_byoton_pact_price.optional_physiology: Noticeably warm skin and episodic fevers, mild persistent distortion of taste and pain intensity, faint antiseptic/decaying blossom scent (more obvious with heavy use); do not forcibly flatten PC mental emotions or mandate 39-40°C baseline. No automatic plague on whole surrounding room.
permanent_byoton_pact_price.cost_continuity: This is already part of blood curse and gradually irreversible even if Shiki refuses Utsuro's instructions. Can attenuate exposure and acute pathology but NOT completely cancel the contract/gaunt phenotype/hazard. No NPC knows full mechanics without observations or investigation.
